title: The best literary magazines to submit to, by tier
seoTitle: Best Literary Magazines to Submit To in 2026, by Tier
description: How literary magazine tiers and rankings work, eleven magazines worth reading for poetry, fiction and essays, which ones pay, and how to order your list.
summary: What makes a magazine top tier, how rankings work, eleven magazines worth reading first, and how to order your submission list.
primaryKeyword: best literary magazines to submit to
secondaryKeywords: best poetry magazines to submit to
answer: The best literary magazines to submit to are the ones whose taste, form and terms fit your finished work. Use tiers to organize ambition, not as a universal quality score. Compare prize recognition, readership, pay and how you submit, then build a short list of well-known journals and smaller magazines you’d actually read.
keyPoints: Read a ranking’s method first: Garstang counts Pushcart honors, Missa scores six measures.
Match form and length before reputation: Brevity takes 750 words or fewer, One Story 3,000–8,000.
Poetry lists US$500 per text poem, One Story US$500 per story, Brevity a US$45 honorarium.
illustrationAlt: Illustration of three steps for building a magazine shortlist: read the work, compare terms, choose a group.
